metadataRaw.title: How to Fix Outer Knee Pain FOR GOOD
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly relieve outer (or lateral) knee pain.

A common cause of this pain is from strain and sprain of the muscles and soft tissues that support the outer knee. This includes the iliotibial band, glutes, and tensor fasciae latae. 

We're going to fix this by doing exercises that will help stretch and strengthen for quick (and long-lasting) outer knee pain relief.

To get the best results, make sure to go through all parts and exercises and use what gives the most relief.

Watch now and get rid of outer knee pain at home!
